rows.text: Los sistemas electrónicos pueden ayudar a evitar un choque, como el ABS, o reducir las lesiones durante el impacto, como la unidad de control de las bolsas de aire.
evidence: Audi, Introduction: Passive Versus Active, p. 3, https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2013/MC-10068885-6903.pdf: active systems help avoid crashes; passive systems mitigate injuries and include airbag control.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca VERO. El ABS modula la frenada para limitar el bloqueo y ayudar a conservar la dirección. No garantiza una distancia total de detención menor: también influyen la reacción, la velocidad y la adherencia.
evidence: UK Highway Code rule 120 https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/general-rules-techniques-and-advice-for-all-drivers-and-riders-103-to-158 — ABS assists steering in emergency braking, does not guarantee a shorter stop; UK technical driving guidance, not Italian law.

rows.text: El ABS actúa durante el frenado para evitar el bloqueo de las ruedas y ayudar a conservar la dirección; no reduce el consumo durante la aceleración.
evidence: UK Highway Code, rule 120, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/general-rules-techniques-and-advice-for-all-drivers-and-riders-103-to-158: ABS helps retain steering but does not guarantee shorter stopping distance.
Bosch, Mobility innovations, ABS and wheel speed, https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/company/milestones/: ABS adjusts braking force when sensors detect wheel lock.

rows.text: El ACC regula la velocidad y la distancia al vehículo delantero; el ABS ayuda a conservar la dirección al frenar. ABA puede designar asistencia de frenado de emergencia, a veces integrada con ACC: las siglas no son sinónimos universales.
evidence: Bosch, Adaptive cruise control, operation principle, https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/assistance-systems/adaptive-cruise-control/: ACC adjusts speed and follows a set distance, usually using radar; driver remains responsible.

UK Highway Code, rule 120, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/general-rules-techniques-and-advice-for-all-drivers-and-riders-103-to-158: ABS helps retain steering but does not guarantee shorter stopping distance.

Mercedes-Benz Trucks, safety assistance systems, https://special.mercedes-benz-trucks.com/en/the-e-econic/technical-data/equipment/safety-assistance-systems.html: identifies Active Brake Assist (ABA) separately from adaptive cruise control; the quiz uses ABA as an alternative label, which is manufacturer-dependent.

Daimler OC 500 https://www.daimlertruck.com/en/newsroom/pressrelease/revolutionary-advancements-in-mercedes-benz-oc-500-chassis-enhanced-safety-efficiency-and-driver-support-52860636 — ABA 6 is emergency brake assist with adaptive cruise as added feature on this chassis; naming and integration vary.

rows.text: El ACC ajusta la velocidad para mantener una distancia configurada con el vehículo delantero, dentro de sus límites; el conductor sigue siendo responsable. ABA no es un sinónimo universal: en algunos sistemas designa asistencia de frenado de emergencia y puede incluir funciones de crucero adaptativo.
evidence: Bosch adaptive cruise control https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/assistance-systems/adaptive-cruise-control/ — speed and following distance regulated within limits; driver responsible.

Daimler OC 500 https://www.daimlertruck.com/en/newsroom/pressrelease/revolutionary-advancements-in-mercedes-benz-oc-500-chassis-enhanced-safety-efficiency-and-driver-support-52860636 — ABA 6 denotes Active Brake Assist, emergency braking; adaptive cruise described as an added feature in this specific chassis.

rows.text: En muchas configuraciones el ACC usa radar para detectar la distancia y velocidad relativa del vehículo delantero y ajustar la velocidad. También puede usar cámara. ABA puede designar asistencia de frenado de emergencia, a veces integrada con funciones de crucero adaptativo.
evidence: Bosch ACC https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/assistance-systems/adaptive-cruise-control/ — radar commonly used and camera may complement it; passenger-car example.

Bosch Sense radar https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/mobility-topics/automated-driving-sense-think-act/sense/ — radar detects position and relative speed; manufacturer description, not a universal architecture.

Daimler OC 500 https://www.daimlertruck.com/en/newsroom/pressrelease/revolutionary-advancements-in-mercedes-benz-oc-500-chassis-enhanced-safety-efficiency-and-driver-support-52860636 — ABA 6 emergency braking, adaptive cruise as added function; model-specific.

rows.text: El ASR limita el patinamiento de las ruedas motrices al acelerar; el ABS gestiona el bloqueo de las ruedas al frenar.
evidence: UK Highway Code, rule 120, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/general-rules-techniques-and-advice-for-all-drivers-and-riders-103-to-158: ABS helps retain steering but does not guarantee shorter stopping distance.

ZF/WABCO Maintenance Manual MM0112 §4.1 https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/abs_maintenance_manuals_/MM0112_web.pdf — ATC/ASR applies brake to spinning driven wheel or reduces engine power in example systems.

rows.text: El ASR puede frenar la rueda motriz que patina; mediante el diferencial esto permite aplicar más par a la otra rueda que conserva adherencia.
evidence: ZF/WABCO Maintenance Manual MM0112 §4.1 https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/abs_maintenance_manuals_/MM0112_web.pdf — ATC/ASR applies brake to spinning driven wheel or reduces engine power in example systems.

Protean Electric, Wheel Torque and Speed https://www.proteanelectric.com/wheel-torque-and-speed-in-vehicles-with-in-wheel-motors/ — braking a spinning wheel permits additional torque at the opposite wheel through an open differential; configuration-dependent physical explanation.

rows.text: El control de tracción es electrónico y actúa sobre el patinamiento de las ruedas motrices; no es un dispositivo puramente mecánico que actúe en todas las ruedas.
evidence: Bosch, Mobility innovations, traction control system, https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/company/milestones/: an electronic control unit reduces spinning of driven wheels.

issues.reason: Il verdetto VERO attribuisce all’ABS la riduzione dello spazio totale di arresto senza condizioni; la fonte autorevole dice che non si deve presumere uno spazio più breve. Occorre decidere se la formulazione intenda una possibilità limitata o esprima una garanzia incompatibile con la fonte.
checked_sources: UK Highway Code, rule 120, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/general-rules-techniques-and-advice-for-all-drivers-and-riders-103-to-158: ABS helps retain steering but does not guarantee shorter stopping distance.

Bosch, Mobility innovations, https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/company/milestones/: il controllo ABS regola la frenata in risposta al bloccaggio, senza stabilire una riduzione universale dello spazio totale.

issues.reason: Il quesito identifica ACC e ABA come nomi alternativi della regolazione adattiva; la fonte del costruttore distingue ABA (Active Brake Assist) dal cruise control adattivo. Non è verificato che ABA sia un sinonimo nel contesto del quesito.
